notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 Notes
notes.content:
Change log to date:

V1.2.1
Tweaked game engine optimisation for smoother frame rates
Added System info regarding potential performance issues
Added ability to change equipment during combat
Added visual and rendering options to the game's main menu
V1.1.0
Added Weakness and Resistance indicators to battle scenes
Added Status effect icons that follow the character/mob in battle scene
V1.03
Fixed an issues with Archonils dialogue freezing
V1.02
Fixed an issue with tutorial graphics not loading
